scope: Read-only saved fixture item/support audit; no runtime/world changes.
cause: Staged GameTest deliberately replays the same template after initial placement. Vanilla StructureTemplate clears the old container contents but retains its unopened loot table, then replaces the chest with BARRIER; chest removal unpacks and drops that loot before the new chest is loaded. First placement into the prepared empty fixture has no existing chest to remove.
evidence: BossStructureExpansionTests.expandedBossLayoutsHaveWalkableBranchesAndPersistedResidents explicitly places all camp chunks twice.
Pinned Forge mapped-official StructureTemplate.placeInWorld calls Clearable.tryClear followed by setBlock(BARRIER) for NBT blocks.
Pinned RandomizableContainerBlockEntity.clearContent clears getItems only; it does not clear lootTable.
Saved dropped IDs exactly match camp loot, including charcoal, leather chestplates and baked potatoes; no unsupported decoration drop IDs.
limitation: Repeated template placement could similarly replace a chest outside QA if deliberately reprocessed; normal newly generated chunks place their clipped template once. No unsupported house geometry found.
